title: pi-jfrog-boost settings
description: Settings for the pi-jfrog-boost extension, read from $PI_JFROG_BOOST_SETTINGS or <pi agent dir>/jfrog-boost.json. Global only: a repository cannot change them. An invalid value falls back to its default with a warning; unknown keys are ignored.

enabled.description: Persisted master switch. DISABLE_BOOST/BOOST_DISABLED, --no-boost and /boost on|off take precedence.

shell.description: "auto" follows Boost's boost-cli-filtering flag; "on" forces it for pi's own Boost calls (environment only, Boost's config is never written); "off" never sends shell output. Env: PI_BOOST_SHELL.

fullOutput.description: Re-filter pi's full output file when bash output was truncated.

minBytes.description: Skip shell and log output smaller than this many bytes.

documents.description: Convert PDF, Office and OpenDocument reads to text (needs Boost's Preview Agreement accepted). Env: PI_BOOST_DOCUMENTS.

notebooks.description: Convert whole reads of .ipynb files of 16 KiB or more. Needs documents on and Boost's Preview Agreement.

readLogs.description: Compact whole reads of *.log and *.out files through the shell filter (needs shell compaction on, like bash). Off by default: a lossy filter can misfire on generic logs.

mcp.description: Compact mcp__* tool results through Boost's MCP filters. Boost stores the full request and response bodies locally and sync uploads them. Env: PI_BOOST_MCP.

mcpExclude.description: Glob patterns of MCP tool names never sent to Boost, e.g. "mcp__secrets__*". `*` is the only wildcard; any character other than letters, digits and _ counts as _ in both the pattern and the tool name, so "mcp__my-server__*" matches both mcp__my-server__ tools and pi's sanitized mcp__my_server__ tools.

extraTools.description: More tool names whose output is routed like bash, e.g. "fetch".

footer.description: Show Boost's state and savings in pi's footer.

badges.description: Per-row transcript badge on results Boost changed (pi 1.0.1 or later).

awareness.description: Tell the model, in a system prompt section, which output Boost may shorten and how to recover it.

sync.description: Run `boost sync` when the agent settles, which uploads Boost's measurements to JFrog. Env: PI_BOOST_SYNC.

observe.description: Lifecycle telemetry to Boost, including tool input and output excerpts. Env: PI_BOOST_OBSERVE.
